summary: Frontend-only testing of Prochem Tapasya mega-menu navigation and 34-slug product detail pages. Executed a comprehensive Playwright flow covering homepage load, mega menu open/close (hover, ESC, route-change), all 9 categories, category-to-product hover, mega-product navigation, all 17 product-page sections, product-name presence for every one of the 34 unique slugs, unknown-slug redirect, model-tab switching, FAQ accordion, mailto/tel RFQ and download links, related-product navigation, homepage anchor scrolling (Lenis, 3s wait), product-page->#about hash navigation, and mobile hamburger menu. 22 assertions passed. No console errors detected on any tested page. No broken images. Only 1 minor discrepancy (data-driven, not a bug): the coating category has only 3 products in data so tablet-coating-machine shows 2 related cards instead of 3.

issues: When the current product's category contains exactly 3 items (e.g. coating: tablet-coating-machine, perforated-coating-pan, coating-system, or pelletising: 2 items), the related section renders only 2 (or 1) cards instead of 3 because it slices from same-category minus self. Consider filling with cross-category related items to always show 3.

action_items: OPTIONAL: augment PRODUCT_DETAILS related computation to top up to 3 items using nearest categories when the current category has <4 products (affects coating & pelletising).
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx line 247: `const isDark = !scrolled && location.pathname !== '/' ? false : false;` is a dead ternary — always false. Safe to remove.

ProductPage.jsx gallery renders p.gallery.slice(0,2) then slice(2,5) — most products only have 3-4 gallery images so the two blocks work; but the aspect ratio classes differ between the two slice blocks which can create minor layout inconsistency on md screens (cosmetic only).

data/products.js: 'octagonal-blender' is listed in both 'blending' and 'special' categories and 'oscillating-granulator' in both 'granulating' and 'milling'. As intended per spec, both resolve to a single detail page — verified.

MegaMenu uses hover to open but click-outside overlay is only rendered inside the AnimatePresence (below the header); works fine due to top-20 fixed positioning. onMouseLeave on the container closes it — good UX.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 34 product slugs verified rendering. Mega menu hover/ESC/route-change all work. Lenis smooth-scroll requires ~3s wait before asserting scrollY. RFQ email/tel links verified. Related-count expectation of exactly 3 fails only for categories with <4 items (coating, pelletising) — this is data-driven.
rca of the issue: Related products count <3 on tablet-coating-machine: PRODUCT_DETAILS build in /app/frontend/src/data/products.js at line ~1511 does `(cat?.products || []).filter(rp => rp.slug !== p.slug).slice(0, 3)` — coating has only 3 products so after excluding current only 2 remain. Mitigation: extend to fall back to other categories when count < 3.
